text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, the beach! ☆ Isn't the sparkling
sand just
wonderful, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's like being on a fancy vacation!
Y'know, like,
Dubai vibes! ☆ Or
something like that!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: We're still very much in Japan, though!

text_block_list.text:
...Um, could someone please explain
what is
happening?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't I be training? What of my
schedule?
And why is Falcon here?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I beseech you... Please explain
what this
is all about!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There's nothing like a taking a vacation
to let off
some steam! Like living it up in
Dubai! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Taking Смарт Фалкон's advice, I arranged
a trip
to... a relatively close beach since
Dubai wasn't
really an option.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, I used Umadol ☆ Power to bring
you all this
way! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...Umadol Power? Is that what you call
the
extreme manhandling you gave me?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Aw, you gotta let bygones be bygones!
You're
here now, so enjoy yourself!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We can have cute drinks, or laze around
on the
beach... Oh, suntanning isn't an
option, though.
Skin damage is a no-go
for an Umadol like me!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought. Honestly, I am
touched
you'd do this for me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However... I can't afford to frolic on the
beach
right now. I must return to my
training at once—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh. You're not going anywhere.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can tell you've been in a really
bad
place lately.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You used to come home at the same
time every
day, but now there's no
telling when you'll be
back... And you're
always rushing around every
waking
minute.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's like you can't do what you really
wanna do.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You always support me with anything
and
everything I want to do...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: So I started wondering if there's anything I could do for you.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And there is! There's something I
definitely can
do! After all, I'm an
Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: And Umadols can brighten anyone's day! ☆ If you hang out with me, you're guaranteed to feel better!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...That is the most illogical reasoning
ever.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But it's true! ☆ So just forget about
everything for
today and live it up with
me!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
C'mon! If we just start walking, I bet
we'll find
something to do eventually!
Any ol' direction will
work, so let's—
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Are you telling me you have no set plan?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Um...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Tell me what you wish to do other than
relax on
the beach.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'll look into the nearby tourist locations
and
create the perfect plan for us.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You're awesome, Flash! I'll leave it to
you,
then! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And with that, we slowly get into
vacation mode
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! That church is huuuge.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It seems they are holding an exhibition
on the
historical stained glass windows
inside. Would
you like to see it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: You bet! ...Hehe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Hm? Why are you laughing?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that I managed to find

something you like. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And that makes you happy? You are
truly an odd
one.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Then, around the time Эйсин Флэш starts
to
relax...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm stuffed... Ugh, the
heartburn...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I told you not to add extra whipped
cream to
your order...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Aww, come on. It's not like you don't
have a big
sweet tooth too.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I do. That is why I didn't add extra
cream, so I
could savor my dessert
without suffering
heartburn.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But don't you secretly wanna try
absolutely
smothering your dessert in
the stuff?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
In my youth, I once made myself very
sick by
doing so. Never again.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: You really are amazing, Flash...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...How do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I always, always pile an entire mountain
of
whipped cream on my pancakes, and I
always
regret it afterwards.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I stay up too late using my phone and
oversleep,
flunk my tests, and never
finish my homework. I
know it's bad, but
I still do all that. Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But not you, Flash. You find a goal,
make a plan,
and see it through to the
end.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You learn from all your mistakes and
never
hesitate on your path. You always
march straight
on forward.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's why I think you should just go for
it and do
what you want! ♪ I know you
can accomplish
anything you set your
mind to!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Whether or not the race is worthy of my
pride as
a racer. In other words, G1
races—races that only
the best in the
world can run.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This is the most optimal race schedule I
can
devise for myself.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: No, I...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон's earnest words of
encouragement
ring true and clearly
move Эйсин Флэш. Now
might be my
chance...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What is it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: ...Pardon?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I have changed clothes... but are you
truly serious
about this?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I cannot understand. A human stands no
chance
against an Umamusume in a race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Well, you are racing on sand instead of turf, so who knows? Do your best, Trainer! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Ready? On your marks, get set...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: The race is settled as soon as it starts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Are you all right, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: I lost by a hundred lengths...

text_block_list.text:
That's an exaggeration. Now, would you
please
explain why you asked to race
me?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Why did you ever make such a foolish

proposition?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You don't seem happy you won.

text_block_list.text:
Naturally. What joy is there in defeating
such an
easy opponent?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: But that's exactly what you proposed.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
There's no pride in winning after fleeing from a
challenge.

text_block_list.text:
The perfect schedule is designed for
victories that
have meaning because
they offer a challenge.
There's no point
in winning just because you can.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
More specifically, it's utterly pointless
for Eishin
Flash. She's worked so hard for
so long to get to
this point. What she
needs right now is to...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Win a race that you want to win.

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Don't you want to win in the G1?

text_block_list.text:
I... do. I want to compete at a high
level... and be
victorious.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I, too, believe there is pride to be had in

accomplishing such an achievement.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But... what meaning is there in taking on
a
challenge that may be impossible to
overcome?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Is it so strange that I would rather
change my
plans so I can win in front of
my parents?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
At last, Эйсин Флэш confesses her true
feelings. If
only there was something I
could do to help her
get over this fear of
failure...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Where your running leads you is up to
you.
text_block_list.name: Мистер Си Би

text_block_list.text: In that case...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
